title: DirectX 9 retired, DirectX 11 GPU now required
summary: The minimum PC requirements changed to a DirectX 11-compatible graphics card, and the DirectX 9 renderer was phased out over an eight-week rollout that ArenaNet expected to finish by 18 April 2023.

title: End of Dragons story continues: "What Lies Beneath"
summary: A free update for End of Dragons owners added the Gyala Delve map, new story and the final Soo-Won legendary variant skin collection. Unlike older Living World episodes, it never needs to be unlocked with gems.

title: "What Lies Within" concludes the End of Dragons story
summary: This update ended the End of Dragons storyline and expanded Gyala Delve with a new meta-event, siege turtle adventures and two skiff races. It also made the Thruster Control Units needed for the siege turtle mount purchasable in Gyala Delve.

title: Relics replace the six-piece rune bonus
summary: A new relic equipment slot now carries the special effects that a full set of six runes used to grant, and runes give only their stat bonuses. 40 core relics are available without any expansion; 12 more need Secrets of the Obscure.

title: Weaponmaster Training: elite-spec weapons on any build
summary: Weaponmaster Training lets each profession equip the weapons that previously required an elite specialization (for example, warrior dagger or necromancer greatsword) without that trait line. It is unlocked through Secrets of the Obscure; the elite specialization trait lines still need their own expansions.

title: Secrets of the Obscure launches
summary: The fourth expansion launched with the Skywatch Archipelago and Amnytas maps, the Wizard's Tower hub, rift hunting, an easier route to the skyscale mount, new masteries and two strike missions. Its story continued in quarterly updates.

title: Wizard's Vault replaces daily achievements and login rewards
summary: The Wizard's Vault replaced daily login rewards and the generic daily achievements with rotating daily, weekly and special objectives that pay Astral Acclaim, which is spent in a reward shop. Any account with a level 80 character can use it, but some rewards and the vault's in-game location need Secrets of the Obscure.

title: "Through the Veil": first Secrets of the Obscure update
summary: Added three story chapters, the Inner Nayos map, 50-player Convergences against legendary Kryptis and a Cosmic Observatory challenge mode. From this update on, missed Wizard's Vault cosmetics move to a legacy tab instead of expiring.

title: One new weapon type for every profession
summary: Each profession gained one more weapon proficiency: ranger mace, thief axe, warrior staff, revenant scepter, mesmer rifle, elementalist pistol, guardian pistol, necromancer sword and engineer short bow. It shipped with the second Secrets of the Obscure update.

title: "The Realm of Dreams": second Secrets of the Obscure update
summary: Added three story chapters, an expanded Inner Nayos, the craftable legendary relic, tier-one Obsidian legendary armor and a Temple of Febe challenge mode.

title: Cosmetic inspection
summary: Players can view another player's equipped skins and dyes (through the portrait menu or /inspect) without seeing stats, runes or sigils, and the inspect cannot be used on enemies in PvP or WvW.

title: Sixth guild slot and custom action-camera reticle
summary: Every account can now join six guilds instead of five, and the action-camera targeting reticle can be recoloured and reshaped.

title: "The Midnight King" ends Secrets of the Obscure
summary: The final Secrets of the Obscure update finished the story and Inner Nayos with a new meta-event, and added the Lonely Tower fractal, a Convergence challenge mode and the upgrade to Suffused Obsidian legendary armor.

title: WvW World Restructuring goes always-on
summary: From the 14 June reset, WvW World Restructuring ran permanently as an always-on beta, ending server relinking. Matchups are built from teams that are reshuffled periodically around each player's chosen WvW guild, instead of fixed home worlds.

title: Homesteads
summary: An account-wide personal instance is unlocked through the Janthir Wilds story. Players decorate it, grow it through a Homesteading mastery, reach it from anywhere with a conjured doorway, and make decorations with the new account-wide Handiworker crafting discipline.

title: Warclaw becomes an open-world mount
summary: The warclaw, previously a WvW-only mount, can be used in PvE and gains new skills and a mastery line, including no fall damage and a buff to endurance regeneration for all mounts. Its WvW skills were also reworked to help against gates and walls.

title: Janthir Wilds launches
summary: The fifth expansion launched with two new maps in the Isles of Janthir, personal homesteads, spears as a land weapon and the warclaw as an open-world mount. A new raid and the rest of the story followed in quarterly updates.

title: Spears become a land weapon for all professions
summary: Every profession got a land spear with its own skill set, unlocked through the first Kodan mastery or bought in WvW. ArenaNet states that this combat feature requires owning Janthir Wilds.

title: Guild Wars 2 on the Epic Games Store
summary: The free core game and all five expansions went on sale on the Epic Games Store in North America and Europe. Epic accounts cannot be linked to Steam or ArenaNet accounts, but all three play together.

title: Mount Balrior: first new raid in five years
summary: Mount Balrior, a 10-player raid wing, opened with the Godspawn update. Its normal mode is tuned for pickup groups, and challenge and legendary modes came in later updates.

title: "Godspawn": first Janthir Wilds update
summary: Added three story chapters, a 50-player Convergence against the titans, the legendary spear Klobjarne Geirr, a new mastery tier, more expansion relics and a Wizard's Vault season.

title: "Repentance": second Janthir Wilds update
summary: Added the Mistburned Barrens map, new story chapters, the Mursaat Shadowcraft mastery track, challenge modes for the Mount Balrior bosses and 12 new core relics.

title: Rift essences become a wallet currency; inventory clean-up
summary: Rift essences moved from the inventory into the wallet. All players can buy the Wizard's Gobbler, which merges over 20 portable exchangers into one item. Faction provisioners switched from a daily to a weekly limit, research notes got a new recipe, and the homestead decoration cap doubled to 2,000.

title: "Absolution" ends Janthir Wilds
summary: The final Janthir Wilds update concluded the story and added the Bava Nisos map, the Kinfall fractal, the Ura Convergence and the legendary backpack Orrax Manifested.

title: Skimmer can dive and gains new abilities
summary: Mastery upgrades learned during the Castora story let the skimmer dive underwater, ride ley lines and updrafts, and use new abilities: a sonar ping, a speed boost and water jets.

title: Skimmer quality-of-life for every owner
summary: Every skimmer owner, with or without masteries, can now dismount in mid-air and mount up while in combat.

title: Visions of Eternity launches
summary: The sixth expansion launched with two maps in Castora, a homestead island and shareable homestead layouts, the legendary aquabreather Selachimorpha and the legendary Aetheric Anchor. Its story is told over four releases into 2026.

title: Nine new elite specializations
summary: Visions of Eternity added nine elite specializations, one per profession, among them the engineer's Amalgam and the ranger's Galeshot.

title: Fashion Templates
summary: A new Fashion tab saves whole cosmetic looks (skins and dyes) as templates that can be swapped and shared by chat code. Two templates are free, and up to nine total can be bought from the Black Lion Trading Company.

title: Wizard's Vault refresh
summary: Daily and weekly objectives were reworked: some were retired, new ones point to fractals, world bosses and WvW, and the daily and weekly category can be chosen separately. The shop gained Black Lion Chest Keys and a bag slot expansion.

title: Unlimited Bag of Coins removed from the Wizard's Vault
summary: The unlimited Bag of Coins listing was removed. The limited gold reward now pays more gold per season at a slightly higher Astral Acclaim cost, which ArenaNet says is meant to curb gold inflation.

title: First Visions of Eternity update: new raid encounter and legendary ring
summary: The first Visions of Eternity quarterly release added the Guardian's Glade raid encounter (its challenge mode three weeks later), six new combat relics and the legendary ring Endless Summer. Per the post, this release focused on systems and added no new map.

title: Strike missions merged into raids; raid quickplay
summary: Strike missions became raid encounters in one raid system with a new raid UI, weekly reward gating and a reward vendor. A quickplay queue matches players into eight easier encounters, such as Aetherblade Hideout and Old Lion's Court, with a group-wide bonus effect.

title: Prophet Shards converted to Magnetite Shards
summary: Prophet Shards were converted into Magnetite Shards, leaving Magnetite Shards and Gaeting Crystals as the only raid currencies. The weekly Magnetite cap rose to 800.

title: Fashion Templates cover mounts, gliders and skiffs
summary: A new Travel section lets players manage and dye mount, glider, conjured doorway and skiff skins, and a Current Fashion tab changes looks without saving a template.

title: "The Only Way": second Visions of Eternity update
summary: Added five story chapters, the Eternity's Garden map, the craftable legendary accessories Stella Radians (PvE) and Strife Unending (WvW), new masteries and six expansion relics.

title: Guild Wars 3 announced
summary: ArenaNet announced Guild Wars 3 for PC and PlayStation 5, set in Orr, with a beta planned for autumn 2027. Guild Wars 2 players received a Summer Game Fest bonus event to mark the announcement.

title: No new expansion after Visions of Eternity for now
summary: ArenaNet said that once Visions of Eternity ended in September 2026, the Guild Wars 2 team would work on the game's foundations rather than a new expansion, starting with a Hall of Monuments update and then spending nearly a year revisiting older eras of the game.

title: "Code of Creation" ends Visions of Eternity
summary: The final Visions of Eternity update added six story chapters, the Leyspring Hollows map, the Solitary Throne fractal, the Nexus of Eternity raid and Convergence, the legendary sword Wages of Stars and the Rift Amplification mastery. ArenaNet's post says expansions are now paused in favour of the Hall of Monuments and quality-of-life work.

title: Living World no longer sold separately
summary: Living World episodes can no longer be bought individually. Purchases made after 12 Sep 2026 were refunded in gems automatically, including a partial refund for the Elder Dragon Saga Complete Collection.

title: New Astral Ward Saga bundle; Elder Dragon Saga updated
summary: Elder Dragon Saga now bundles Heart of Thorns, Path of Fire and End of Dragons with Living World Seasons 3 to 5. The new Astral Ward Saga bundles Secrets of the Obscure, Janthir Wilds and Visions of Eternity, and the Complete Collection covers all six expansions plus Seasons 3 to 5.

title: Starter Pack gains extra items
summary: At the same price, the Starter Pack now also contains a Copper-Fed Salvage-o-Matic, five Teleport to Friend items and two Black Lion Chest Keys, and earlier buyers received them by mail.

title: Living World Season 2 is free
summary: Living World Season 2, which bridges the core story and Heart of Thorns, is now free for every account with a level 80 character, joining the already-free Season 1.

title: Living World Seasons 3 and 4 included with Heart of Thorns and Path of Fire
summary: Living World Seasons 3 and 4 are now part of the Heart of Thorns and Path of Fire purchase, and existing owners automatically received any episodes they were missing.

title: The Icebrood Saga included with End of Dragons
summary: Living World Season 5 (The Icebrood Saga) is now included with End of Dragons, and existing owners automatically received any episodes they were missing.
